segments.vo: In nineteen thirty-two, an army went to war with emus. And lost.
This really happened.
It happened in Western Australia's wheat country, near Camp-ee-un.
segments.cap: It happened in Western Australia's wheat country, near Campion.

segments.vo: Many farmers there were World War One veterans.
segments.cap: Many farmers there were World War One veterans.

segments.vo: The Depression had hit them hard.
segments.cap: The Depression had hit them hard.

segments.vo: Then about twenty thousand emus moved onto their land.
segments.cap: Then about 20,000 emus moved onto their land.

segments.vo: The giant birds raided the wheat crops the farmers depended on.
segments.cap: The giant birds raided the wheat crops the farmers depended on.

segments.vo: The farmers asked for help. The government sent soldiers.
segments.cap: The farmers asked for help. The government sent soldiers.

segments.vo: Major Meredith of the Royal Australian Artillery took command.
segments.cap: Major G.P.W. Meredith of the Royal Australian Artillery took command.

segments.vo: His men brought two Lewis machine guns and ten thousand rounds.
segments.cap: His men brought two Lewis machine guns and 10,000 rounds.

segments.vo: On November second, nineteen thirty-two, the operation began.
Days later, they ambushed about a thousand emus near a dam.
segments.cap: Days later, they ambushed about 1,000 emus near a dam.

segments.vo: After just twelve birds were killed, the gun jammed.
segments.cap: After just 12 birds were killed, the gun jammed.

segments.vo: After six days, the soldiers were pulled out.
segments.cap: After 6 days, the soldiers were pulled out.

segments.vo: Then they were sent back in, until December.
segments.cap: Then they were sent back in, until December.

segments.vo: Meredith claimed nine hundred eighty-six kills, with nine thousand, eight hundred sixty rounds.

scenes.quote: They can face machine guns with the invulnerability of tanks.

segments.vo: Meredith later said the emus could face machine guns with the invulnerability of tanks.
segments.cap: Meredith later said the emus could face machine guns "with the invulnerability of tanks."

segments.vo: When farmers asked for the army again in nineteen thirty-four, they were refused.
segments.cap: When farmers asked for the army again in 1934, they were refused.

segments.vo: Instead, hunters got bounties. About fifty-seven thousand were claimed in six months.
segments.cap: Instead, hunters got bounties. About 57,000 were claimed in 6 months.
